setting: Grid-based city with a hidden bunker

characters.name: Brave Survivor

inventory.name: Awakened Fruit
inventory.description: A mysterious fruit now pulsing with activated energy, casting light that reveals hidden patterns. Its frequency attracts both lasers and enemy targeting systems.

goals: Solve the mystery code before the gate seals
Defeat the massive entity descending from above
obstacles: Shifting laser beams that hunt and rewrite their patterns
Mystery code etched into the bunker's core
Rival's missile pods with fruit-frequency targeting
3-minute countdown until obby's final gate seals
Massive entity descending through blast doors

characters.name: The Rival

inventory.name: Missile Pods
inventory.description: Mechanical flower-like pods that unfold to reveal targeting systems locked to the Awakened Fruit's frequency

goals: Claim the Awakened Fruit for themselves
obstacles: Brave Survivor's agility and fruit possession

locations.name: Hidden Bunker
locations.description: A secret underground bunker with a mystery to uncover. Now a active combat zone with self-rewriting laser grids and a pulsing core mystery code.
obstacles: Shifting laser beams that hunt and rewrite their patterns
Mystery code etched into the bunker's core
Rival's missile pods targeting the fruit
Massive entity breaching through blast doors

locations.name: Grid-based City
locations.description: The main city where players interact and play. Something massive is descending from here into the bunker.

locations.name: Obby
locations.description: A challenging obstacle course to conquer. Final gate seals in 3 minutes.
locations.timeLimit: 3 minutes until final gate seals forever

plot.mainQuest: Claim the awakened fruit, solve the mystery code, survive the rival and massive entity, and conquer the obby before the final gate seals
plot.timeLimit: 3 minutes until obby's final gate seals forever
plot.consequencesOfFailure: Darkness consumes everything; the obby becomes inaccessible; the Awakened Fruit's power is lost to enemies
plot.currentState: The true battle hasn't started. It's just waking up. Three-way conflict: Brave Survivor vs Rival vs Massive Entity, with Darkness orchestrating.
